People: John Russell Bartlett (author, Wikidata Q1101332), died 1886. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Bartlett, John Russell, 1805-1886") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: The progress of ethnology : an account of recent archæological, philological and geographical researches in various parts of the globe, tending to elucidate the physical history of man , New York : Printed for the American Ethnological Society, 1847, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/progressethnolo01bartgoog.
